stem.text: Which statements help to explain the mechanism of the reaction between 1-chloropropane and ammonia?

items: 1-chloropropane has a $\delta^{-}$ chlorine atom that forms hydrogen bonds with a $\delta^{+}$ hydrogen atom in ammonia.
1-chloropropane is a polar compound with a $\delta^{+}$ carbon atom.
There is a lone pair of electrons on the nitrogen atom in ammonia.
